title: How it works
intro: Four steps from the trip to everyone being square.

create.title: Create a group
create.text: Name the trip, pick the currency and add the group. Everyone's expenses live in one place.

invite.title: Invite your people
invite.text: Share the invite link or code. Friends join with or without an account.

scan.title: Scan a receipt
scan.text: Take a photo, let the AI read the items, then tap who had what. Prices are converted into the group currency.

settle.title: Settle up
settle.text: Splitbon works out the fewest payments. Pay by PayPal link, bank-transfer QR code or cash and mark it as paid.
